art_instructions: Draw a small, cozy one-room schoolhouse made of warm brown wood with a bright yellow door and windows, sitting on short stilts. The owl, a small brown-and-cream bird with round amber eyes and a green scarf, is walking out of the schoolhouse through the open yellow door. The owl holds her tiny satchel and looks slightly tired but content, with her head turned slightly back as if saying goodbye. The schoolyard has scattered fallen leaves, daisies, and a small stone pathway leading away from the entrance. No other characters are visible, and the scene is sunny with bright, soft lighting. Use pastel colors and Korean aegyo cute style with smooth lines and minimal detail. The owl should be the central focus, drawn in chibi proportions (2–3 heads tall).
